title: Irembo Companion — Journey Data Model
description: Artifact-based service-dependency model. Services CONSUME and PRODUCE artifacts; the dependency graph, path-finding, cost/time roll-ups and 'what is blocking me' are all derived by matching service.requires (artifact ids) against service.produces. Rules are attached per service and carry the mitigation the agent side-panel performs.

notes.description: Free-text provenance/scope note for the dataset.

updatedAt.description: Date the dataset content was last verified.

sourceConfidence.description: Provenance of the rules/fees. 'verified' = confirmed against an official source or agent interview; 'needs-verification' = drafted, must be confirmed (Q4).

artifact.description: A document, status, decision or credential that a service consumes or produces. Edges in the dependency graph are artifacts.

issuedBy.description: agency id that produces this artifact.

expirable.description: Has a validity window; eligibility rules may check freshness.

reusable.description: Candidate for a consented document vault — same artifact reused across journeys.

note.description: Used for variable/unknown to explain the basis (e.g. 'depends on turnover band').

condition.description: Boolean test over the citizen profile. Either a leaf comparison (var/op/value) or a composite (allOf/anyOf).

rule.description: A checkable failure point. The engine evaluates these to warn the agent BEFORE submission (human-in-the-loop).

failureMode.description: What actually happens if the rule is violated. Not all failures are explicit rejections — some are silent (tax) or lead to operating illegally (missing sector permit).

when.description: Optional: rule only applies when this condition holds.

message.description: Plain-language description of the failure point.

mitigation.description: What the companion / side-panel does to pre-empt it.

requires.description: artifact ids this service consumes (incoming edges).

produces.description: artifact ids this service emits (outgoing edges).

optional.description: Not always part of the path.

appliesWhen.description: If present, the service is only on the path when this holds.

service.description: svc id referenced at this step.

hidden.description: TRUE for the 'invisible tail' — steps the citizen usually doesn't know exist (district license, sector permits). The core product value is surfacing these.

journey.description: A life event: an ordered composition of services toward an outcome.

goalPhrases.description: Natural-language phrases that map a citizen's stated intent to this journey (NLU seed).

outcomeArtifacts.description: The artifacts that together mean 'done & legally operating'. Note: more than just the registration certificate.
